sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 31 points from 14 games, travel to Dawley Town on Saturday at 14:00. The league leaders come into this fixture off the back of a recent loss, though their broader form remains strong with four wins in their last six league matches. This early kick-off represents a key opportunity for Sandbach to maintain their advantage at the summit.
divisionWide: The chasing pack will be keen to capitalize on Sandbach's stumble. Second-placed AFC Bridgnorth are not in action this weekend, but third-placed Bilston Town hold strong recent form with five wins in their last six league games. Stafford Town (4th, 26 points) host Telford Town in a fixture between mid-table and one of the division's struggling sides. Eccleshall (5th) face Shawbury United at home, while Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Allscott Heath in a clash of upper-mid-table teams. Barnton host Foley Meir in a battle between sides with contrasting recent form—Barnton unbeaten in four league matches versus Foley Meir's inconsistency. New Mills welcome Wednesfield Community in a fixture between two mid-table sides. Market Drayton Town travel to face Crewe, a struggle between two lower-division teams, while Cheadle Heath Nomads host Brereton Social and Widnes Town visit Alsager Town at the division's basement, where both teams are desperately seeking points.
